-- usr/local/bin/notes -> /home/alice/bin/notes --
-- srv/home/bob/.config/systemd/user/rclone-mount.service --
[Unit]
Description=Mount the cloud drive

[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/bin/rclone mount cloud: /home/alice/Cloud --log-file=/home/alice/.cache/rclone.log

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
